svg.title: CareerOps — Job Search Workflow and Tracking Process
svg.desc: Five stages: Search and Collect, Filter and Evaluate, Prepare and Apply, Track and Monitor, Recommend and Iterate. Includes a synthetic search funnel, illustrative role weights and synthetic application statuses. A conceptual reference workflow, not a live dashboard.

g.text: From Search to Offer — End-to-End Workflow
